newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.AFRICA'S HARMONY ACQUIRES LYDEX.
newsitem.headline: S.AFRICA'S HARMONY ACQUIRES LYDEX.

text.p: South Africa's Harmony Gold Mining Co Ltd announced on Monday that it had acquired a 44.8 percent stake in Lydenburg Exploration Ltd from life assurer Old Mutual for 89.5 million rand.

The purchase price comprises a cash payment of 10 rand per share for the 6.4 million Lydex shares held by Old Mutual plus 45 Harmony options for every 100 Lydex shares held, Harmony said in a statement.
Each option entitles the holder to acquire one Harmony share at a price of 60 rand at any time until July 31, 2001.
Randgold and Exploration Co Ltd will buy the Harmony options, which are to be listed on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange, from Old Mutual at a price of 8.89 rand per option.
The total purchase price equates to 14 rand per Lydex share.
Harmony managing director Bernard Swanepoel said the acquisition was in line with the company's strategic objective of pursuing new business opportunities beyond the mine's current lease boundaries.

"Generally the Lydex acquisition will accelerate Harmony's development from a gold producer into a more broadly based and better balanced gold mining and exploration company, with enhanced strategic and operational options," Swanepoel said.
